def calculate_irr_bonuses_annual_tax(payslip,claim_code,year,pay_cycle,paycycle_gross,irregular_gross): total_gross_with_irr = (irregular_gross / pay_cycle)+paycycle_gross
tax_amount_gross_without_irr = payslip.env['fed.tax'].get_tax_amount(paycycle_gross,claim_code,year,pay_cycle) tax_amount_gross_with_irr = payslip.env['fed.tax'].get_tax_amount(total_gross_with_irr,claim_code,year,pay_cycle)
irr_pay_tax = tax_amount_gross_with_irr - tax_amount_gross_without_irr annual_irr_pay_tax = irr_pay_tax * pay_cycle return annual_irr_pay_tax,tax_amount_gross_without_irr
is_pay_cycle = employee.salary_pay_cycle.pay_cycle if is_pay_cycle: pay_cycle = int(is_pay_cycle) claim_code = employee.federal_claim_code_from_td1 year = employee.deductions.slab_year
paycycle_gross = GROSS-categories['PRE_TAX_DEDUCTION']
irregular_gross = categories['ADD_ALLOWANCE']
irr_gross_percycle = 0.0 previous_annual_irr_pay_tax=0.0 previous_tax_amount_gross_without_irr = 0.0 if irregular_gross>0.0: previous_irregular_payment=payslip.env['hr.payslip'].get_previous_irregular_payment(payslip.id,pay_cycle) if previous_irregular_payment > 0.00: irregular_gross += previous_irregular_payment annual_irr_pay_tax,tax_amount_gross_without_irr = calculate_irr_bonuses_annual_tax(payslip,claim_code,year,pay_cycle,paycycle_gross,irregular_gross) if previous_irregular_payment>0.0: current_irr_tax_amount = abs(employee.ytd_irre_fed_tax - annual_irr_pay_tax) annual_irr_pay_tax = current_irr_tax_amount payslip.write({'irre_fed_tax': annual_irr_pay_tax}) result = tax_amount_gross_without_irr + annual_irr_pay_tax else: result = payslip.env['fed.tax'].get_tax_amount(paycycle_gross,claim_code,year,pay_cycle) else: result= 0.0
